contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ [GLORIA EXERCITVS] ; D/ FL IVL CONSTANTIVS NOB C

A copper-alloy nummus of Constantius as Caesar, AD 324-337 (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Reverse shows Two soldiers and two standards. Mint is uncertain, AD 330-335. Obverse legend reads FL IVL CONSTANTIVS NOB C. Obverse shows Laureate and cuirassed bust right. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //[...]. Condition is fine, die axis is 12 o'clock, weight is 1.80g,…
